findings.evidence: SUNStructureConstants.lean:40 advertises `* sum_genM_proj — Σₐ Tr(X Tᵃ) Tᵃ = (1/2)(X - Tr(X)/N · 1)` in its '## The derivation' list, but grep for `sum_genM_proj` in that file finds only `sum_genM_proj_apply` (line 220); the matrix form is never declared, while `sum_genM_sandwich` (line 252) is.
findings.fix: Add the matrix-form `sum_genM_proj` next to `sum_genM_sandwich` in `EpsilonEridani/QFT/QCD/SUNStructureConstants.lean` (proved from `sum_genM_proj_apply` by `ext i l` exactly as `sum_genM_sandwich` is proved from `sum_genM_sandwich_apply`), then prove `colorOctetProj_eq` by `ext ψ : 1` plus that rewrite, with no entry indices. This also makes the module docstring true.
findings.issue: `colorOctetProj_eq` descends to entries (`ext ψ i l`, `one_apply_kd`, `ring`) to apply the entrywise `sum_genM_proj_apply`, inlining the reusable matrix-level Fierz identity `∑ₐ Tr(ψ Tᵃ) • Tᵃ = (1/2) • (ψ - (N:ℂ)⁻¹ • Tr ψ • 1)`. The sibling sandwich form already exists at matrix level (`sum_genM_sandwich`, SUNStructureConstants.lean:252) and is used that way in `casimir_genM_apply`; the projection form is left as index bookkeeping.

findings.evidence: `def colorSingletProj (N : ℕ) := ((N : ℂ)⁻¹ • traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ).smulRight 1` (line 83-84) applied to ψ yields `((N:ℂ)⁻¹ • ψ.trace) • 1`; the stated RHS is `((N:ℂ)⁻¹ * ψ.trace) • 1`, equal only through `smul_eq_mul` being `rfl`.
findings.fix: Replace with `by simp [colorSingletProj]` (or an explicit `rw [colorSingletProj, LinearMap.smulRight_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, traceLinearMap_apply, smul_eq_mul]`), so the proof names the lemmas it uses rather than depending on `SMul ℂ ℂ` reducing to `Mul`.
findings.issue: `colorSingletProj_apply` is closed by bare `(rfl)`, which chains three definitional unfoldings: `LinearMap.smulRight_apply`, `LinearMap.smul_apply`, and `smul_eq_mul` on `ℂ` (the statement writes `*` where the definition produces `•`). Reliance on the scalar-action-vs-multiplication defeq is undocumented.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust automation with factored intermediate steps, but `colorOctetProj_eq` inlines the matrix form of the completeness relation by descending to entries, and `colorSingletProj_apply` rests on an undocumented three-step defeq chain.
